The Story

Why is your whole group still arguing about where to eat lunch?

It happens every day in Uptown. One person wants dumplings. One person wants noodles. One person will not decide until everybody else already has. So the group splits up, or everybody settles for the place nobody really wanted.

Maroon Market was built to end that argument. It is a Global Street Food Experience, which means the flavors come from all over the world and land in one place, at one counter, inside Monarch Market in the heart of Uptown Charlotte. Dumplings for you, bao buns for them, noodles for the one who never decides until the last second. Nobody settles. Nobody splits up. And the prices were on this page before you even stood up.
